name: CreateStandingOrderV03
definition: Scope|The CreateStandingOrder message is sent by a member to the transaction administrator.|It is used to create a permanent order for the transfer of funds between two accounts belonging to the same member and being held at the transaction administrator.|Usage|Based on the criteria defined in the CreateStandingOrder message, the transaction administrator will execute or reject the requested creation and respond with a Receipt message as a reply to the request.
